cipher.summary: Added RateLimitSeam (contract/validators/fixtures/mock/probe/test + real in-memory adapter) and wired a shared `enforceRateLimit` guard into all five provider-billed API routes with per-route request budgets.
cipher.risks: The in-memory store is per-warm-instance only; under multi-instance/multi-region serverless scaling, an attacker distributed across cold starts or regions can exceed the intended aggregate budget. This is documented as an accepted best-effort mitigation, not a durable rate limit.
